quotes.name: Amara Keane
quotes.quote: I've noticed more empty storefronts lately, but what strikes me is how quiet the conversations about it have been—like it's just expected now. The Tribune should ask why there's no visible push to fill these spaces when the neighborhood clearly still has demand.

quotes.name: Melton Neilon
quotes.quote: I hear about Grand Lake's shops struggling when I'm buying flour—vendors say foot traffic's down but rents aren't. The Tribune should ask why no one's stitching together the landlords and small biz grants before more windows go dark.
